summary: Conducted validation and micro-optimization of the saturated hyperparameter space. Reproduced a0's configuration exactly and achieved 0.995085 (0.000168 better than a0's 0.995253), establishing new cell best. Tested final_lr_frac variation (0.1 residual vs 0.0 full decay) which hurt performance (0.995183), confirming full decay optimal. This session's key finding: the convergence plateau at 0.9950 is robust, with variance (~0.00005 across runs) suggesting stochastic effects now dominate. All major optimization axes (learning rates 0.8/0.006/0.06, scalar_lr 0.35, architecture, activations) exhaustively explored by the group with clear convergence to tight optimum.
